scope_review.notes: Scope review: De Theologia I-XLIII + De Fide I-XXII + De Authoritate Scripturae Pars I I-XXV from 1675 Pitt Latin. Honest partial densify — Pars I through XXV only; XXVI+ and Parts II-IV remain; not the collected folio. Grounded in sources/_le_blanc_authoritate_latin_lock.txt (expanded). Era: mid-seventeenth-century Reformed Sedan.
